params.prompt:
Image 1 is the CHARACTER: a young man with short blonde hair, a navy T-shirt, grey jeans and grey sneakers. Image 2 is the BACKGROUND SCENE.

Add the character to Image 2. Keep Image 2 unchanged in every other respect — same camera, same framing, same fixtures, same palette. This is a very wide shot of a whole room from high up, so the character is a small part of the picture.

POSITION: sitting in the office chair that is already in the scene, at the long desk with the three monitors on the right-hand wall. Turn that chair so that it faces the desk, in the same spot — do not move it and do not draw a second chair.
SCALE: a full-grown adult at that desk, seen from across the room and from above — seated, the top of his head rises a little above the chair back and sits below the cork board on the wall. He is the largest figure the desk could hold, and no larger.
FACING: he is seen from behind and a little from his right side, three-quarters away from us, facing the monitors. The back of his blonde head and his shoulders are what we see; his face is not visible.
POSE: he sits still and upright at rest, both hands resting flat on the keyboard, feet on the floor under the desk.

Hand-drawn animation pencil test: graphite line, cross-hatch shadow, light coloured-pencil wash, paper tooth showing — no flat vector fill, no digital gradients, no painterly rendering, no 3D. Do not add any text.
